name: Feature request (Markdown)
about: Suggest an enhancement using the markdown fallback template
title: "[Feature]: <short summary>"
labels:

  - type:feature

assignees: ''
---

## :loudspeaker: Introduction
Describe the user problem, personas affected, and the value unlocked if solved.

## :world_map: Guide
Share the current workflow or journey that needs improvement (steps, commands, UI flow).

## :control_knobs: Customization
Outline the desired UX/API surface, configuration knobs, or interaction model.

## :clipboard: Requirements
List acceptance criteria, success metrics, and non-functional constraints (performance, security, localization, etc.).

## :triangular_ruler: Technologies
Call out integrations, migrations, data models, or dependencies this change touches.

## :warning: Warnings
Highlight compatibility risks, rollout considerations, training/support impacts, or phased delivery needs.

## :memo: To-do list
Break the work into discovery, design, implementation, validation, and documentation tasks.
